title: serde_json::to_value(...).unwrap_or(Value::Null) pattern silently emits null on serialization failure
description: Pattern appears ~20 times across email.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, submission.rs, vacation.rs. If SetError or any result object fails to serialize, the client gets null in the error map instead of the error description. The client then sees a null notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed entry with no type, which is not a valid SetError and will confuse callers. SetError is always serializable so the failure cannot currently happen, but it is an invisible invariant. Fix: use .expect("SetError is always serializable") to make the invariant explicit, or define a typed serialization helper that returns Result.
